sem.images: SEM-like PGM images focusing on ITZ. 512x512 uint8 grayscale.

metrics.csv.sem_crack_length_mm: Total crack length estimated from binary cracks across views (mm).
metrics.csv.sem_itz_width_px: ITZ shell width used for analysis (pixels).

metrics.csv.xrd_ch_rel_area: Integrated area around main CH peaks (relative).
metrics.csv.xrd_caco3_rel_area: Integrated area around main calcite peaks (relative).

micro_ct.*_slice_[Z|Y|X].pgm: Central slices previews in PGM grayscale.

metrics.csv.ct_itz_width_vox: ITZ shell width used for porosity boost (voxels).
